$comment: SEC-18 (security item 5): the only modules that may import node:child_process, with a one-line reason each. Worktree code runs through runConfined() (packages/sandbox/src/confined.ts); a module that runs it may not appear here. Shrink this list; never grow it without a reason a reviewer accepts. `runTrusted` lists the modules that call runTrusted(), the same way.
